subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should publisher-wide installation cover skills only, require an explicit publisher-curated bundle, or dynamically install every skill and plugin currently owned by the publisher?
rationale: The choices have materially different consent, supply-chain, compatibility, and cross-repository implications that cannot be selected from existing behavior alone.

options.title: Require curated bundles
options.body: Let publishers explicitly version a bundle whose members are previewed before the existing skill and plugin installers process them.

options.title: Support skills only
options.body: Add publisher-scoped bulk skill installation while leaving plugins on their existing explicit per-package path.

options.title: Install every listing
options.body: Dynamically resolve all current publisher skills and plugins and install them with mixed partial-failure handling.

recommendation.title: Require curated bundles
recommendation.body: Let publishers explicitly version a bundle whose members are previewed before the existing skill and plugin installers process them.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to this request, the adjacent CLI organization proposal, and recent publisher-scoped install resolution work.
